summary_1line: After ominous portents, Dhritarashtra grants Draupadi boons freeing the Pandavas; Karna acknowledges her saving them, and Bhima fumes at the humiliation.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal hall, Draupadi stands before blind king Dhritarashtra as he grants her boons that free the Pandavas from bondage.
A jackal howls inside the palace sacrificial chamber while asses bray and ominous birds cry across the darkened court.
Bhima, blazing with wrath like a burning tree, glares across the assembly as sparks seem to burst from his body.
